## [1.0.0-dev.4](https://github.com/Sudashiii/servus-patches/compare/v1.0.0-dev.3...v1.0.0-dev.4) (2026-10-09)

### ✨ New Features

* Add "Reject cookie banner" patch ([#6](https://github.com/Sudashiii/servus-patches/issues/6)) ([2bb5bb2](https://github.com/Sudashiii/servus-patches/commit/2bb5bb20b12c8ae717306aa22c0698ed8ab00ebb))

patches.name: Block forced updates
patches.description: Disables Google Play in-app update prompts and makes 'Update required' messages dismissible, so the patched app can't be locked out by a forced update.

patches.name: Disable review prompts
patches.description: Stops the app from asking for a Play Store rating after watching videos or adding favorites.

patches.name: Disable tracking
patches.description: Makes the app behave as if all tracking consent was declined, so Braze, Datadog, Red Bull analytics, GfK and Datazoom never start and Crashlytics and Firebase Analytics don't collect data.

patches.name: Disable video ads
patches.description: Removes pre-roll and mid-roll ads (Google IMA) from videos and live channels.

patches.name: Reject cookie banner
patches.description: Skips the cookie consent banner on first launch and saves 'Reject all' instead, as if you declined it. The privacy settings in the app stay available.
